remarks: Step into refined luxury at 255 Bruce Park Avenue, Unit D-a sophisticated 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath townhouse in the heart of downtown Greenwich. Built in 2019, this 2,400 sq. ft. residence features a private elevator, rich hardwood floors, and an open-concept design perfect for modern living. The gourmet kitchen boasts top-tier appliances, flowing seamlessly to a private patio ideal for alfresco entertaining. The serene primary suite includes a custom walk-in closet and spa-like ensuite, complemented by two additional bedrooms with private baths. An attached garage, central vacuum, and energy-efficient upgrades complete this elegant home, just moments from Greenwich's finest amenities.
